newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.LANKA SAYS TO CONCLUDE AIR LANKA DEAL SOON.
newsitem.headline: S.LANKA SAYS TO CONCLUDE AIR LANKA DEAL SOON.

text.p: Sri Lanka, which this week sold part equity in its state-owned telecom utility, plans to privatise its national carrier Air Lanka very soon, a top government official said on Thursday.

"Air Lanka's technical evaluation is going on. Now that we have completed Sri Lanka Telecom (SLT), we can focus on Air Lanka. Within the next two-three months we hopefully can conclude another successful transaction like SLT," P.B. Jayasundera, chairman of Public Enterprise Reform Commission told a news conference.
Jayasundera declined to give further details.
Sri Lanka plans to sell 40 percent equity and management in the national carrier to a strategic investor.
It sold 35 percent equity and management in Sri Lanka Telecom to Japan's Nippon Telephone and Telegraphic Corp for $225 million on Tuesday.
